categoryDescriptions.scheduling: Booking, moving, or cancelling a consultation or meeting; asking about availability.
categoryDescriptions.billing: Invoices, retainers, payments, fee questions, and payment arrangements.
categoryDescriptions.intake: A prospective client describing a new matter and asking whether the firm can take it, or what the intake process involves.
categoryDescriptions.case-question: A question from an existing client about their open matter: status, next steps, documents, deadlines, or advice about it.
categoryDescriptions.other: Anything that fits none of the above: office logistics, records requests, vendors, job applicants, general questions.
